summary: Meta's Alexandr Wang announced Muse Spark 1.2, a multimodal model with visual coding, robotics planning and audio-visual understanding capabilities accessible through agentic tools.

practices.reason: The post claims a new capability set (visual coding, robotics planning, audio-visual understanding via agentic tools) but gives no benchmark or figure to substantiate the claim.
practices.quote: muse spark 1.2 is a very strong multimodal model—it can do visual coding, robotics planning, and audio-visual understanding that all come together through agentic tools.
